## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test -race ./...` pass locally
- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior and its error paths
- [ ] Public APIs have GoDoc comments
- [ ] Docs, examples, and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated if public behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data are included
